title: Be Thou, O God, by Night, by Day
description: Be Thou, O God, by Night, by Day in Tonic Solfa to YORK, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in the supplement of the 1866 edition of A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1866), as hymn 551, “Morning Hymn”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to YORK; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Be Thou, O God, by night, by day, My guard, my guide from sin, My life, my trust, my light di-vine, To keep me pure with-in.

lines: Be Thou, O God, by night, by day,
My guard, my guide from sin,
My life, my trust, my light divine,
Pure as the air, when day's first light
And active as the lark that soars
Till heaven shines round its plumes.
So may my soul, upon the wings
Till at the gate of heaven it sings,

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1866.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1866); set to YORK by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
